d:
Jab se nitish kumar ne bihar ke mukhyamantri pad ki kursi chhori hai, tab se janta dal yunaited men tut ki ataklen chal rahi hain. tejasvi yadav aur prashant kishor samet kaee vipakshi dalon ke neta lagatar dave kar rahe hain ki jediyu khatm ho jaegi. vidhan parishad chunav ke bad nae sire se isko lekar bahas chhir gaee hai.
